typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DUMMY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'1\' AS DUMMY',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCDUMMY
SRCDUMMY derive(FILENAME = replace($OutboundFiles, toString('.txt'), toString('')),
		COUNT = $Cnt) ~> DERCOUNTS
DERCOUNTS sink(input(
		Column_0 as string,
		Column_1 as decimal(0,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = FILENAME,
		Column_1 = COUNT)) ~> FFDSTCONTROLFILE
